name: shdr-32
title: SHDR-32
description: A galaxy marched as a volume of gas and dust inside the ball: a flared exponential disc under a Gaussian bulge, modulated by log-spiral arms and broken into filaments by four octaves of feedback-curl turbulence, accumulated front-to-back with a blue-weighted extinction so thick gas reddens what lies behind it — the dust lanes fall out of the physics. Hashed stars sit at each ray's exact hit with the galactic plane, veiled by the dust in front of them. The disc tips between states: a calm three-quarter spiral at rest, a face-on boiling whirlpool while searching, a face-on flaring spiral breathing on the beat while answering.
